neighbours.label: A list on a broad, gate-closed pole: Arabic ' ذات', and 'atin' in satin, 'auté' in sauté, ' satire'; other words in those slots stay low.
fire: هذا الأمر مهم في حد ذاته.
إصلاح ذات البين واجب على الجميع.
Her gown is lined in pale silk-satin.
The pillow has a silk-satin cover.
Heat the pan. Sauté the onions in a little butter.
Melt the butter. Sauté the garlic over high heat.
The film is a biting satire on politics.
His novel is a gentle satire of village life.
quiet: هذا الأمر مهم في كل الأوقات.
Her gown is lined in pale silk-cotton.
The pillow has a silk-cotton cover.
Heat the pan. Boil the onions in a little water.
Melt the butter. Stir the garlic over high heat.
The film is a biting attack on politics.
His novel is a gentle portrait of village life.

notes: Probes: 0.48-0.82; 'الحداثة' only 0.07 although the card tops with it. Near misses 0.03-0.07. No pattern that I can see.
